causes.detail: 16/16 cases passed; two MKCOL missing-parent cases emitted non-failing RFC 409 warnings.
After basic leaves content in /litmus/, each later group DELETE gets 409; collection remains mapped.
Each later group MKCOL then gets 405 because prior DELETE 409 left /litmus/ mapped; not an independent creation failure.

Independent fresh-parent run outcomes: COPY overwrite 412 matches the existing-destination rejection boundary; COPY into a missing destination collection incorrectly succeeded; collection COPY and replacement/collection MOVE returned 501 because those operations are unsupported by the Phase A contract. Later MKCOL 405 in that independent sequence is also dependent on a previous failed cleanup.
Feature boundary is intentionally unsupported by current WebDAV contract; default suite cannot reach these cases after setup failure, so no current run case is counted as unsupported.

The contract intentionally returns 501 for LOCK/UNLOCK and PROPPATCH/dead properties; the default run failed group setup before issuing these requests, so they are not counted as observed run outcomes.

independent_reproduction.delete_mkcol: 2026-11-16 raw debug log directly links DELETE 409 then MKCOL 405; default run again shows all four later groups fail at their begin setup.
